The '''Baralou system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Varada sector/Legends|Varada sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and was centered around the yellow [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Baralou (star)|Baralou]]. The system contained four [[Planet/Legends|planets]] and one [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] between the planets [[Baralou]] and [[Masalou]].
